ruleDefinitions.name: Scheduled Task Executing Encoded Payload from Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a schtask that potentially executes a base64 encoded payload stored in the Windows Registry using PowerShell.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*encodedcommand.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-ItemProperty.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ gp\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*HKCU\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*HKLM\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*registry\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*HKEY\\_.*")))
